Weng.Geometry
Class Line

java.lang.Object
  |
  +--Weng.Geometry.Line
All Implemented Interfaces:
Elem
public class Line
extends java.lang.Object
implements Elem

Use this class to create an object representing a geometric line. This class does not create an line entity in the modeler, but is intended to be used for performing geometric calculations.
